lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਇਆ ਨਗਰ ਮਹਿ ਰਾਮ ਰਸੁ ਊਤਮੁ ਕਿਉ ਪਾਈਐ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਜਨ ਕਰਹੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaaiaa nagar mahi raam ras ootam kiu paaeeai upades jan karahu ||
lines.translation: Within the body-village is the Lord's supreme, sublime essence. How can I obtain it? Teach me, O humble Saints.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਸਫਲ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਮਿਲਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਅਹੁ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: satigur sev saphal har darasan mil a(n)mrit har ras peeahu ||2||
lines.translation: Serving the True Guru, you shall obtain the Fruitful Vision of the Lord's Darshan; meeting Him, drink in the ambrosial essence of the Lord's Nectar. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਮੀਠਾ ਹਰਿ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਚਾਖਿ ਦਿਖਹੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: har har naam a(n)mrit har meethaa har sa(n)tahu chaakh dikhahu ||
lines.translation: The Ambrosial Name of the Lord, Har, Har, is so sweet; O Saints of the Lord, taste it, and see.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਮੀਠਾ ਲਾਗਾ ਤਿਨ ਬਿਸਰੇ ਸਭਿ ਬਿਖ ਰਸਹੁ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: guramat har ras meethaa laagaa tin bisare sabh bikh rasahu ||3||
lines.translation: Under Guru's Instruction, the Lord's essence seems so sweet; through it, all corrupt sensual pleasures are forgotten. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਸੁ ਰਾਮ ਰਸਾਇਣੁ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਹੁ ਸੰਤ ਜਨਹੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: raam naam ras raam rasaain har sevahu sa(n)t janahu ||
lines.translation: The Name of the Lord is the medicine to cure all diseases; so serve the Lord, O humble Saints.

lines.gurmukhi: ਚਾਰਿ ਪਦਾਰਥ ਚਾਰੇ ਪਾਏ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਭਜਹੁ ॥੪॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: chaar padaarath chaare paae guramat naanak har bhajahu ||4||4||
lines.translation: The four great blessings are obtained, O Nanak, by vibrating upon the Lord, under Guru's Instruction. ||4||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
lines.transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 4 ||
lines.translation: Bilaaval, Fourth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਖਤ੍ਰੀ ਬ੍ਰਾਹਮਣੁ ਸੂਦੁ ਵੈਸੁ ਕੋ ਜਾਪੈ ਹਰਿ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੁ ਜਪੈਨੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: khatree braahaman sood vais ko jaapai har ma(n)tr japainee ||
lines.translation: Anyone, from any class - Kh'shaatriya, Brahman, Soodra or Vaishya - can chant, and meditate on the Mantra of the Lord's Name.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਕਰਿ ਪੂਜਹੁ ਨਿਤ ਸੇਵਹੁ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਸਭ ਰੈਨੀ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: gur satigur paarabraham kar poojahu nit sevahu dinas sabh rainee ||1||
lines.translation: Worship the Guru, the True Guru, as the Supreme Lord God; serve Him constantly, all day and night. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਦੇਖਹੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਨੈਨੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: har jan dekhahu satigur nainee ||
lines.translation: O humble servants of the Lord, behold the True Guru with your eyes.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਇਛਹੁ ਸੋਈ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਵਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਬੋਲਹੁ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਬੈਨੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: jo ichhahu soee phal paavahu har bolahu guramat bainee ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Whatever you wish for, you shall receive, chanting the Word of the Lord's Name, under Guru's Instruction. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਨਿਕ ਉਪਾਵ ਚਿਤਵੀਅਹਿ ਬਹੁਤੇਰੇ ਸਾ ਹੋਵੈ ਜਿ ਬਾਤ ਹੋਵੈਨੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: anik upaav chitaveeahi bahutere saa hovai j baat hovainee ||
lines.translation: People think of many and various efforts, but that alone happens, which is to happen.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਪਨਾ ਭਲਾ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਈ ਬਾਛੈ ਸੋ ਕਰੇ ਜਿ ਮੇਰੈ ਚਿਤਿ ਨ ਚਿਤੈਨੀ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: apanaa bhalaa sabh koee baachhai so kare j merai chit na chitainee ||2||
lines.translation: All beings seek goodness for themselves, but what the Lord does - that may not be what we think and expect. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਕੀ ਮਤਿ ਤਿਆਗਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਏਹਾ ਬਾਤ ਕਠੈਨੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: man kee mat tiaagahu har jan ehaa baat kathainee ||
lines.translation: So renounce the clever intellect of your mind, O humble servants of the Lord, no matter how hard this may be.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵਹੁ ਗੁਰ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਮਤਿ ਲੈਨੀ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: anadin har har naam dhiaavahu gur satigur kee mat lainee ||3||
lines.translation: Night and day, meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, Har, Har; accept the wisdom of the Guru, the True Guru. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਤਿ ਸੁਮਤਿ ਤੇਰੈ ਵਸਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਹਮ ਜੰਤ ਤੂ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਜੰਤੈਨੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: mat sumat terai vas suaamee ham ja(n)t too purakh ja(n)tainee ||
lines.translation: Wisdom, balanced wisdom is in Your power, O Lord and Master; I am the instrument, and You are the player, O Primal Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਰਤੇ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਜਿਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਵੈ ਬੁਲੈਨੀ ॥੪॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: jan naanak ke prabh karate suaamee jiu bhaavai tivai bulainee ||4||5||
lines.translation: O God, O Creator, Lord and Master of servant Nanak, as You wish, so do I speak. ||4||5||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
lines.transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 4 ||
lines.translation: Bilaaval, Fourth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਨਦ ਮੂਲੁ ਧਿਆਇਓ ਪੁਰਖੋਤਮੁ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਅਨਦ ਅਨੰਦੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: anad mool dhiaaio purakhotam anadin anad ana(n)de ||
lines.translation: I meditate on the source of bliss, the Sublime Primal Being; night and day, I am in ecstasy and bliss.

lines.gurmukhi: ਧਰਮ ਰਾਇ ਕੀ ਕਾਣਿ ਚੁਕਾਈ ਸਭਿ ਚੂਕੇ ਜਮ ਕੇ ਛੰਦੇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: dharam raai kee kaan chukaaee sabh chooke jam ke chha(n)de ||1||
lines.translation: The Righteous Judge of Dharma has no power over me; I have cast off all subservience to the Messenger of Death. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਪਿ ਮਨ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਗੋੁਬਿੰਦੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: jap man har har naam goubi(n)de ||
lines.translation: Meditate, O mind, on the Naam, the Name of the Lord of the Universe.

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਏ ਪਰਮਾਨੰਦੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: vadabhaagee gur satigur paaiaa gun gaae paramaana(n)de ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: By great good fortune, I have found the Guru, the True Guru; I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord of supreme bliss. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਕਤ ਮੂੜ ਮਾਇਆ ਕੇ ਬਧਿਕ ਵਿਚਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਫਿਰਹਿ ਫਿਰੰਦੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: saakat mooR maaiaa ke badhik vich maaiaa phirahi phira(n)de ||
lines.translation: The foolish faithless cynics are held captive by Maya; in Maya, they continue wandering, wandering around.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਜਲਤ ਕਿਰਤ ਕੇ ਬਾਧੇ ਜਿਉ ਤੇਲੀ ਬਲਦ ਭਵੰਦੇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: trisanaa jalat kirat ke baadhe jiu telee balad bhava(n)de ||2||
lines.translation: Burnt by desire, and bound by the karma of their past actions, they go round and round, like the ox at the mill press. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੇਵ ਲਗੇ ਸੇ ਉਧਰੇ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਸੇਵ ਕਰੰਦੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh sev lage se udhare vadabhaagee sev kara(n)de ||
lines.translation: The Gurmukhs, who focus on serving the Guru, are saved; by great good fortune, they perform service.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿਆ ਤਿਨ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਭਿ ਤੂਟੇ ਮਾਇਆ ਫੰਦੇ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: jin har japiaa tin phal paaiaa sabh toote maaiaa pha(n)de ||3||
lines.translation: Those who meditate on the Lord obtain the fruits of their rewards, and the bonds of Maya are all broken. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਆਪੇ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਸਭੁ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਗੋਵਿੰਦੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: aape thaakur aape sevak sabh aape aap govi(n)de ||
lines.translation: He Himself is the Lord and Master, and He Himself is the servant. The Lord of the Universe Himself is all by Himself.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਸਭੁ ਵਰਤੈ ਜਿਉ ਰਾਖੈ ਤਿਵੈ ਰਹੰਦੇ ॥੪॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: jan naanak aape aap sabh varatai jiu raakhai tivai raha(n)de ||4||6||
lines.translation: O servant Nanak, He Himself is All-pervading; as He keeps us, we remain. ||4||6||

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਪੜਤਾਲ ਘਰੁ ੧੩ ॥
lines.transliteration: raag bilaaval mahalaa 4 paRataal ghar 13 ||
lines.translation: Raag Bilaaval, Fourth Mehl, Partaal, Thirteenth House:

lines.gurmukhi: ਬੋਲਹੁ ਭਈਆ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਤਿਤ ਪਾਵਨੋ ॥ ਹਰਿ ਸੰਤ ਭਗਤ ਤਾਰਨੋ ॥
lines.transliteration: bolahu bhaeeaa raam naam patit paavano || har sa(n)t bhagat taarano ||
lines.translation: O Siblings of Destiny, chant the Name of the Lord, the Purifier of sinners. The Lord emancipates his Saints and devotees.
